context: A teacher reviews a student's essay drafting style
purpose: Teach: 打ち合わせ/一連/頻繁/間違え/不要/意欲/のんびり/書き方

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮くん、エッセイの書き方について少し打ち合わせしたいんだけど、今いい?
lines.en: Ren, I'd like to have a quick meeting about your essay writing style. Got a minute?
lines.style: Teacher's calm, professional tone inviting student conversation

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あ、はい先生。最近、構成を間違えてばかりで悩んでたんです。
lines.en: Oh, yes Sensei. Lately I've been getting the structure wrong and worrying about it.
lines.style: Student speaking honestly with slight nervousness and humility

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 前回の課題ね、一連の段落のつながりがちょっと弱かったかな。
lines.en: About your last assignment, the flow of the connected paragraphs was a bit weak.
lines.style: Gentle teacherly feedback delivered with thoughtful precision

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: やっぱりそうですか。頻繁に話題が飛んでしまうって自覚はあって…
lines.en: I knew it. I'm aware that my topics jump around frequently...
lines.style: Student admitting weakness with reflective self-awareness

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 不要な部分を削れば、もっと意欲が伝わる文章になると思うわ。
lines.en: If you cut the unnecessary parts, your enthusiasm will come through more clearly.
lines.style: Encouraging advice framed in constructive teaching language

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど、削るのが怖くて全部残しちゃうんですよね。
lines.en: I see, I'm scared to cut things so I end up keeping everything.
lines.style: Student voicing genuine creative anxiety in casual register

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 焦らず、週末にのんびり読み返してみるといいわよ。
lines.en: Don't rush — try rereading it leisurely over the weekend.
lines.style: Warm maternal advice with reassuring softness in delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかりました。次の打ち合わせまでに書き方を見直してきます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll rework my writing style before our next meeting.
lines.style: Determined student closing with respectful commitment to improvement
